problem: The frozen local model deterministically emits a Markdown envelope around governed-shape Gate-F JSON despite prompt-only remediation.

selected_design.integration_point: transformers.generate(prefix_allowed_tokens_fn=...) in the evaluation-only Core V1.2 runner
selected_design.terminal_condition: A schema-complete object followed only by EOS
selected_design.nonpass_constraint: one or more reason records and at least one DECISIVE record
selected_design.confidence_constraint: JSON number in inclusive range 0 through 1
selected_design.string_constraint: Valid JSON string escapes; reject unescaped controls

token_projection.method: For each DFA state and decoded partial-token suffix, admit only vocabulary tokens whose decoded bytes keep the character stream extendable to at least one valid terminal object.
token_projection.cache: Cache allowed token IDs by immutable DFA state plus partial literal/string state.
token_projection.special_tokens: Disallow all special tokens except EOS; allow EOS only in a valid terminal state.
token_projection.empty_allowed_set: Abort evaluation and emit ADMISSION_EVALUATOR_FAILURE receipt; never relax the grammar.
token_projection.token_decode_ambiguity: Validate the concatenated decoded token stream, not isolated token labels. Fail closed on non-round-tripping token pieces.

independent_postconditions: Decode generated tokens without stripping, trimming, or repair.
Require the first decoded byte to be left brace and the last to be right brace.
Apply the unchanged GateResponseV2 strict parser.
Require exact Gate-F decision/reason namespace invariants.
Record raw token IDs, raw decoded bytes, constraint identity, parser receipt, and failures.
implementation_stages: Implement the DFA and token projection in an evaluation-only module with no production import edge.
Property-test valid and invalid prefixes, schema invariants, EOS behavior, Unicode/escape handling, and empty-set failure.
Run tokenizer-only exhaustive vocabulary projection checks without loading model weights.
Perform a zero-inference runner preflight with a forbidden model executor.
Only under separate owner authority, execute one unchanged-payload Gate-F constrained contract probe.
Do not authorize Run 3 until the constrained probe passes and its evidence is owner-reviewed.

must_accept: Canonical FAIL with one decisive governed reason
acceptance_contract.performance_preflight: Allowed-token projection must complete within the existing per-gate timeout budget with bounded cache growth.
